A separate mod-2 simplicial-chain computation gives Betti ranks 811 in degree 4 and 84 in degree 5, matching the Morse reduction and Euler characteristic 728. The Hurewicz/Smith-form step is valid because the Morse CW 4-skeleton is a wedge of 4-spheres and hence 3-connected.
